title: WAL page hash and collision probing

scope.rationale: walHash maps positive database page numbers into the power-of-two WAL hash table with multiplier 383, and walNextHash advances collision probes with wraparound.

dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete arithmetic helpers are assigned and consumed by production hash insertion/lookup.

outputs: Initial slot and next wrapped probe slot
contracts.state_and_results: Initial is (page*383) & 8191 with u32 wrapping; next is (slot+1)&8191.

representation_differences: Zig returns usize slots; the source returns int. Values remain bounded to 0..8191.

oracle.protocol: Observe page 1 hashes to 383 and final slot 8191 advances to 0.

assurance.malformed_input: Page zero violates assertion; arbitrary slot values are masked.

integration.native_call_path: Production hash insertion invokes both helpers; direct arithmetic trace covers initial and wrap boundaries.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C seeded hash trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
